reason: Suginami Animation Museum (東京工芸大学 杉並アニメーションミュージアム) is a free Suginami-ward educational facility on the 3rd floor of the Suginami Kaikan community hall, operated by Tokyo Polytechnic University (東京工芸大学). It is an experience/learning center that explains the HISTORY and craft of Japanese animation through rotating, studio-licensed special exhibitions — NOT a collecting institution and it publishes NO openly downloadable, machine-readable catalogue of original flat production art (cels セル画 / backgrounds / 設定資料 / storyboards). Stage 0/1 evidence: site is WordPress (theme 'suginamianime', MetaSlider + XO Event Calendar plugins). The WP REST API IS open (https://sam.or.jp/wp-json/ HTTP 200) and its full route list (177 routes) exposes only standard types (posts/pages/categories/tags/media) plus two custom post types — 'xo_event' and 'xo_event_cat' — which are the XO Event Calendar plugin's special-exhibition EVENT listings (/kikaku/), not an artwork collection. There is no artwork/作品/collection/cel/zushi custom post type, no /collection, /opendata, /api, data.{domain}, robots.txt, or sitemap.xml of object records. The wp/v2/media library (X-WP-Total = 2,478) is a website-asset upload pile: event posters (e.g. 'shinei50th_b2_poster' — a studio-copyright Shin-Ei Animation 50th B2 promo poster, 1200x1696), banners, closure notices ('臨時休館'), and hashed-filename promo graphics — not per-object digitized production art. The '/animelibrary/' (the 'アニメ関連資料のライブラリー' from listings) is a PHYSICAL on-site reference reading room (books, magazines, art-book collections, interview DVDs, 30-min anime-DVD viewing booths, library-only / no copying); its only downloads are PDF text catalogue lists of book/DVD titles, explicitly NOT an online image database of cels/backgrounds/storyboards. All exhibition imagery is studio-copyright-locked licensed material (Keroro, SPY×FAMILY, Shin-Ei 50th, etc.). No machine-readable, openly downloadable ≥600px per-object catalogue of in-scope flat animation art exists on the museum's own infrastructure.

No /opendata, /api, data.sam.or.jp, /collection, /library DB, GitHub dump, Navigart, national-OA, eMuseum/Solr/IIIF/Drupal-jsonapi. robots.txt & sitemap.xml absent. wp/v2/media (2,478 items) = website promo assets (event posters/banners/closure notices), not a per-object artwork catalogue. exhibitions_entry.name: Tokyo Polytechnic University Suginami Animation Museum
exhibitions_entry.description: Japan's first comprehensive animation museum, opened in 2005 and operated by Suginami Ward together with Tokyo Polytechnic University, on the third floor of the Suginami Kaikan hall near Ogikubo Station. Admission is free, and it is an experience-and-learning center that traces the history and craft of Japanese animation — from its origins to the production pipeline — through hands-on exhibits, a theater, workshops, and rotating studio-licensed special exhibitions. It also keeps a physical reference library of anime books, magazines, and interview DVDs. As an educational facility rather than a collecting institution, it publishes no openly downloadable per-object collection of production art, and the works it shows are licensed studio material under copyright.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 2005년 문을 연 일본 최초의 종합 애니메이션 뮤지엄으로, 스기나미구와 도쿄공예대학이 함께 운영한다. 오기쿠보역 근처 스기나미 회관 3층에 자리하며 입장은 무료다. 작품을 소장·전시하는 미술관이라기보다, 일본 애니메이션의 역사와 제작 과정을 직접 체험하며 배우는 학습 공간이다. 체험 전시와 상영관, 워크숍, 그리고 스튜디오에서 허락받아 여는 기획전이 수시로 바뀐다. 애니메이션 관련 서적과 잡지, 제작진 인터뷰 영상을 갖춘 자료 열람실도 있다. 전시 자료는 모두 저작권이 있는 스튜디오 라이선스 작품이고, 외부에서 내려받을 수 있는 개별 작품 단위 컬렉션은 공개하지 않는다.

notes: Address: 〒167-0043 東京都杉並区上荻3-29-5 杉並会館3F (Suginami Kaikan 3F). Free admission, closed Mondays + 12/28-1/4. This is a 区立 (ward) educational facility run by Tokyo Polytechnic University — confirmed pre-probe expectation (Tokyo ward museum, run by Tokyo Polytechnic Univ, likely editorial-only). Same outcome class as toei-museum.json (sibling JP anime museum, also viable:false): no collection infrastructure, studio-copyright-locked art. KEY DIFFERENCE worth recording: unlike Toei (hand-coded static HTML, wp-json 404), Suginami's WordPress REST API IS reachable (wp-json 200, 177 routes) — but inspecting it was decisive PROOF of absence rather than a source: the only custom post types are xo_event/xo_event_cat (event-calendar special exhibitions), and wp/v2/media (2,478) is a website promo-asset pile, not an artwork catalogue. The earlier curl probe with UA 'armin-museum-research/1.0' got connection-level refusals on every path; switching to a browser UA returned HTTP 200 everywhere (the site UA-filters the research agent) — relevant for any future re-probe. No scraper written (per task: STOP at Stage 1 when no catalogue / copyright-locked). exhibitions_entry filled for optional directory inclusion as a venue, but viable:false — nothing to scrape.
